genericHints: Name each part you want (title, button, box).
Ask for one change at a time and say the colours or sizes.

tiles.title: Warm-up: your team's page
tiles.brief: Practise here. Make the heading show your team name, make a Save Point, change something, then Go Back.
tiles.hint: Ask: "Make a big heading with our team name".

hooks.warmup-title: the main heading of this section

items.text: The page heading shows your team name.

tiles.title: Hero banner
tiles.brief: The big welcome banner at the top of the fest page.
tiles.hint: Tell the AI the heading, the tagline and the button text exactly.

hooks.hero-cta: the call-to-action link or button (link it to #register)

items.text: The heading says "IEDC Fest 2026".
The tagline says "Build. Break. Launch."
The background uses a colour gradient.
There is a "Register now" button.

tiles.title: Countdown
tiles.brief: A live countdown to the fest: 15 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM.
tiles.hint: Say what it counts down to, and ask for a message when the time is over.

hooks.cd-days: the number of days left (just the number)
hooks.cd-hours: the number of hours left (just the number)
hooks.cd-minutes: the number of minutes left (just the number)
hooks.cd-seconds: the number of seconds left (just the number)
hooks.cd-message: a message element that is only filled in when the countdown is over

tiles.aiNotes: The fest starts at new Date("2026-12-15T09:00:00+05:30"). Put each number in its own element, next to a text label (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds).

items.text: It counts down to 15 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM.
items.simpleText: It counts down to 15 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM in days, hours and minutes.

items.text: Days, hours, minutes and seconds are in separate labelled boxes.
It updates every second.
A message shows when the time is up.

tiles.title: Schedule
tiles.brief: The fest's sessions: 09:30 Opening (IEDC Team), 10:30 Idea Pitch (Student Founders), 12:00 Build Workshop (Industry Mentor), 14:00 Demo Time (Participating Teams).
tiles.hint: Give the AI all four sessions with their times and speakers.

hooks.session-title: the session title inside a card

items.text: There are 4 session cards, each with a time, a title and a speaker.
The four sessions are Opening, Idea Pitch, Build Workshop and Demo Time.
The cards sit in a neat grid or row.

tiles.title: Registration form
tiles.brief: A form to register for the fest: name, email and department.
tiles.hint: Describe what should happen for an empty form, a wrong email, and a correct one.

hooks.reg-error: the error message element (empty or hidden when there is no error)
hooks.reg-success: the success message element (empty or hidden until the form is sent)

tiles.aiNotes: Handle the form's submit event in JavaScript and call preventDefault(); do not rely on the browser's built-in validation popups (add novalidate to the form).

items.text: It has name, email and department fields.
The department list has at least 5 departments.
Sending an empty form shows an error.
A wrong email (like "asha") shows an error.
A correct form shows "Thanks, <name>!".

tiles.title: Dark/light switch
tiles.brief: A button that switches the whole page between dark and light colours.
tiles.hint: Ask the AI to use the page's colour variables.

hooks.theme-toggle: the button that switches dark mode

tiles.aiNotes: This section only holds the button. Its JavaScript may change a class or data attribute on <html> or <body>, and its CSS may redefine --bg, --fg, --card and --accent for the dark mode.

items.text: There is a button to switch dark mode.
Clicking it switches the page to dark colours.
Clicking again switches back.

tiles.title: Gallery
tiles.brief: Six cards with an emoji or colour block and a caption: Hackathon, Workshop, Demo Day, Mentor Talk, Pitch Night, Networking.
tiles.hint: Name the six captions and say what should happen on hover.

items.text: There are 6 cards in a grid, each with a caption.
The captions are Hackathon, Workshop, Demo Day, Mentor Talk, Pitch Night and Networking.
Cards grow or glow when you hover.

tiles.title: Feedback stars
tiles.brief: Let visitors rate the fest with 1 to 5 stars.
tiles.hint: Describe what happens when you tap star 3, then tap star 5.

hooks.star: each of the 5 stars, in order (selected stars also get data-active="true", others data-active="false")
hooks.rating-text: the text that shows the rating
hooks.rating-thanks: a thank-you message element (empty or hidden until rated)

items.text: There are 5 stars.
Tapping a star highlights that many stars.
The text shows "You rated: N/5".
A thank-you message appears after rating.

tiles.title: Fix-it
tiles.brief: This section came with bugs. Find out what's broken and get the AI to fix it.
tiles.hint: Describe what you see going wrong, not the code.

items.text: Clicking Like adds 1 to the count.
An empty email shows "Please enter an email".
A valid email shows "Subscribed!".
The heading, the Like button and the email field are still there.

changeRequests.text: Please add the line 'Free food for all participants!' to the page.
Please add the line 'Bring your ID card to enter' to the page.
changeRequests.phrase: Bring your ID card to enter

changeRequests.text: Please add the line 'Registration closes on 10 Dec' to the page.
